annotations.title: Coverage for a pair and size

description: How much of the map for a currency pair and size rests on evidence: the coverage tier (evidenced, partial or inferred), how many reconciled outcomes sit behind it, how many candidates carry economics, the reference's publishers, error band and type (hard_peg, derived_peg, fixing_median or home_central_bank), and whether a failure rate is published yet. With country (e.g. CI for XOF), also that country's profile and measured receipts. Free.

amount.description: Optional. Payment size for the size band, in the currency named by amount_basis.

amount_basis.description: Whether amount is what leaves (source) or what must land (destination). Default source.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country, e.g. CI for XOF.

from.description: ISO 4217 code of the source currency (what leaves), e.g. 'ZAR'.

to.description: ISO 4217 code of the destination currency (what lands), e.g. 'USD'.

name: coverage
